notes: Tailscale one-tap sign-in: on a Tailscale Serve URL, the host trusts the tailnet identity Serve forwards and issues a device token, so a fresh install can sign in with no 6-digit desktop code. Welcome -> Sign in with Tailscale, enter your Serve URL (https://host.tailnet.ts.net), done. Missing identity or disabled hosts fall back to a pairing code or recovery link; optional host config restricts to one Tailscale login or disables auto-pair. Also includes recovery links and search role/date filters.
